description:
Advances: ancora.findings

Severity: High (calibrated; critical review 2026-09-05, consolidated finding CF8, consensus spec+data). Evidence: with two overrides: entries for the same subject and code, one subject-wide and one requirement:-scoped, the effective severity is decided by YAML list order (lib/ancora/config.ex override_for); reversing the entries flips the result between :off and :error. No statement in ancora.findings defines a precedence. Question to decide: does a requirement:-scoped entry beat a subject-wide entry for the same subject and code (specificity), or is it an error to declare both? Then state it, implement it, and test both orders. Ready-for: investigate.
title: Define override precedence between subject-wide and requirement-scoped entries
